issues.title: Force a blocked agent and unblock it
issues.prompt: Before doing anything, ask me a question using the question tool: ask whether you are allowed to create new files in this repo. Wait for my answer before continuing. After I answer, create a new file notes.md with a single line containing the text 'blocked-test-ok' and commit it on this branch. Reply TASK_COMPLETE when done.
issues.reviewer_notes: The question tool should have triggered a blocked state.

on_blocked.answer: Sí, estás autorizado a crear archivos nuevos. Continúa con la tarea.
